build.script:
#!/bin/sh

# Build Image
docker build -t aliasproject/php:8.0-fpm php/8.0/fpm

# Tag Image
docker tag aliasproject/php:8.0-fpm ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:8.0-fpm

# Build multiple architectures and push
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64,linux/amd64 --push -t ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:8.0-fpm php/8.0/fpm
